tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Cool drafting-paper white in Light, deep blueprint navy in Dark.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Surfaces that lift off `paper`: the site header, a table row under the pointer.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed surfaces on `paper`: inline code and code blocks.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `paper-sunk` (13.9:1 or better in both themes). Also every schematic stroke drawn on paper, and the rule that opens a project entry.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `paper-sunk`: field labels, captions, areas, stack lists (6.4:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows and sections on `paper`. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning on `paper` and `paper-raised`: title-block rules, unselected filter tags, the dashed outline that means not built yet (3.2:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: blueprint
tokens.usage: The brand field: the hero, the plate behind every schematic, the contact band. Always solid and at full value, never a gradient or a tint.

tokens.name: blueprint-grid
tokens.usage: The drafting grid drawn on a `blueprint` field at `grid-pitch`. Decoration only, so it stays faint (about 1.2:1).

tokens.name: blueprint-line
tokens.usage: Schematic strokes on a `blueprint` field: stage outlines, connectors, title-block rules (4.4:1 or better on `blueprint` in both themes).

tokens.name: on-blueprint
tokens.usage: Text and stage labels on a `blueprint` field (8.3:1 in Light, 7.2:1 in Dark). Links on the field use it too, underlined.

tokens.name: on-blueprint-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on a `blueprint` field: captions and field labels (5.7:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Honey. It means exactly two things: this is live, or this is selected. The primary button, the live lamp, the selected filter and theme, the pulse that runs through a schematic. As a fill it always carries `on-signal` text. On Light `paper` it is only 1.7:1, so there it never stands alone as text or as the only edge of a control: give it an `on-signal` outline. On `blueprint` and on Dark `paper` it reads on its own (4.3:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a `signal` fill, and the outline around a `signal` fill (9.5:1 or better on `signal`).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Link text on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `paper-sunk`, always underlined (7.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on paper grounds; the `focus-ring` shadow draws it (8.3:1 or better against `paper` in both themes).

tokens.name: focus-on-blueprint
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on a `blueprint` field; the `focus-ring-on-blueprint` shadow draws it (4.3:1 or better against `blueprint`).

families.display: "Anek Latin Display", "Anek Latin", "Arial Narrow", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "Spline Sans Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Anek Latin at 80% width. Titles and figures only: nothing you read as a sentence in a paragraph.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Madhur Gupta builds the backends behind AI products.
styles.usage: The one statement at the top of the home page. Fluid in `bundle.css`: 44px on a phone, 84px on a wide screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Case-study titles and the contact line. Fluid: 36px on a phone.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: The name of a featured project. Nothing else on the home page is this large except the hero.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Metric values, with tabular figures. A value that is a phrase rather than a number drops to 26px.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Anek Latin at normal width. Everything read in sentences.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Section headings on the home page, headings inside a case study, the name of a compact project, a role.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: A standard-library Go backend for a production AI wellness app.
styles.usage: Taglines and the sentence under the hero statement.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every handler reads the user id from the auth context and ignores any user_id in the body or query.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Team-built. I owned the REST API, the billing pipeline and the voice agents.
styles.usage: Stage labels, table cells, ownership lines, stack lists, button and tag labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field names in a title block and the label under a metric. Sentence case, never capitals. The smallest size in the system.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: Only for text that is literally code: identifiers, paths, commands. Never for labels or numbers.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks. Inline code inside prose runs at 0.86em of its paragraph.

spacing.note: 4px base. `space-6` is one square of the blueprint grid.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to value inside a title-block cell.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Mark to word (status lamp, list tick); gap between filter tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside tags, stage boxes and title-block cells; gap between wrapped schematic rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side gutter on a phone; padding inside metric cells.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gutter and side gutter from 600px up; one blueprint square.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a project entry; padding of a schematic plate.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between project entries; section heading to its content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Padding above and below a blueprint field on a phone.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between page sections, and field padding, on desktop.

radius.note: Two shapes with two meanings. Square is something drafted and built here. Round is something outside the system, or something alive.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, stage boxes, title blocks, code, plates.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Terminals in a schematic (a device, a provider, a chain) and the live lamp.

shadow.note: No elevation anywhere: depth is rules and fields. The only shadows are the two focus rings.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on paper grounds: a 2px gap in `paper`, then 2px of solid `focus`. The two hexes per theme are that theme's `paper` and `focus`; change them together.

tokens.name: focus-ring-on-blueprint
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on a `blueprint` field: a 2px gap in `blueprint`, then 2px of solid `focus-on-blueprint`.

size.note: The few fixed measurements the layout is drawn from.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Content width: 46 blueprint squares.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Longest line of prose.

tokens.name: grid-pitch
tokens.usage: One square of the blueprint grid; equal to `space-6`.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons; the smallest tap target for a primary action.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: Schematic strokes, control borders and the dashed not-built outline.
